item.title: mac4DSTEM 5.3.1
item.description:
Bug Fixes
* a cube from another file no longer shows the previous file's EDS maps (#327) (345776b), closes #322 * a file the app may not read is refused as unreadable; StaleTaskJourney opens its fixture in place (#359) (bf36437) * a new dataset starts with an empty phase list (#317) (20b4414) * a typed orientation relationship stands for all its variants in the matrix (#358) (8c81635) * an empty virtual detector and an origin with no measured position are refused (#343) (37e71e7) * Calibrate Q from crystal reads diamond [110] rings from {111} (double-diffraction shells, DiffractoKit 0.16.0) (#352) (28daf6b) * calibrated Bragg vectors keep the count of positions where detection failed (#328) (8042c20), closes #302 * fine-tuning scales a windowed pattern's dose as inference does (#335) (fc654dd) * Fit Distortion from Spots fits Phase mapping's matrix, not the last added phase (#316) (e174530) * opening a dataset writes nothing on its volume (read-only Recents bookmark) (#329) (4d23857) * phase mapping refuses an origin that is not a measured beam centre (#346) (7e14151) * placing a virtual detector no longer moves the origin; Prepare sets a centre by hand (#360) (899a12a) * release: new Sparkle update key after the keychain loss (#287) (9252fb1), closes #285 * sidebar task rows and Workspace › Next/Previous Task choose the task through accessibility and the keyboard (#319) (5db2ba1) * the task bar shows one ellipsis, no rate, and a spaced Cancel (#362) (d9ac2cf) * the UI test runner keeps one signature in gate and drive runs (#331) (0b35b25) * Thronsen A parity pin moves to the 98.59 % main reads (accepted drift) (#354) (aae9cc8) * Thronsen A parity pin moves to the 98.59 % main reads (accepted, #345) (aae9cc8)
